assessment: CD4 Th2 effector cells contribute to immune responses to helminths and allergens. There exists little information on Th2 cell heterogeneity and clonal distribution between organs. In this manuscript, Radtke et al. investigate the transcriptional signatures of CD4 Th2 cells in the mesenteric lymph nodes and lungs during helminth infection. By using single cell RNA-sequencing including TCR clonotype analysis, the authors define distinct and overlapping transcriptional signatures and clonal relatedness between CD4 Th2 cells in two different tissues at the peak of a type 2 immune response in vivo.
